are-coprime: Give true if the arguments are coprime.
carmichael-lambda: Give the Carmichael function λ(n). C($n) -- An integer.
chinese-remainder: Give the smallest x with x>=0 that satisfies all the integer congruences x mod m_i == r_i mod m_i. C<:@r> -- List of remainders. C<:@m> -- List of modules C<:$d> -- Number, lower limit of the result.
circular-chords-tracing: Circular chords tracing. C<$n> -- Positive integer. C<:&with> -- Function to derive the chords with. C<:d(:$dataset>) -- Should a dataset be returned or not.
continued-fraction: Generate a list of the first $n terms in the continued fraction representation of $x.
convergents: Give a list of the convergents corresponding to the given continued fraction terms list or a number.
cousin-primes: Get the first n-pairs of primes that differ by 4.
digit-count: gives the number of digits in a base representation of the argument. C<$n> -- Integer C<:$base> - Base (integer) C<:$digits> -
divisor-sigma: Give the divisor function σ(exp, n).
divisors: Give a list of the integers that divide the argument.
euler-phi: Gives the Euler totient function ϕ(n) that counts the positive integers up to a given integer n that are relatively prime to n. C<$n> -- Number.
extended-gcd: Gives the extended greatest common divisor of the integers n[i].
factor-integer: Give a list of the prime factors of the integer $n, together with their exponents. If the second argument $k is number then th sub does partial factorization, pulling out at most $k distinct factors.
factorial: Give the factorial of the argument. C<:$n> -- Integer.
fibonacci: Give the n-th Fibonacci number. C<$n> -- Non-negative integer or a list of non-negative integers.
frobenius-number: Gives the Frobenius number of a[0], a[1], ...
frobenius-solve: Gives a list of all solutions of the Frobenius equation a[0] * x[0] + ... + a[n]*x[n] == b.
from-continued-fraction: Reconstruct a number from the list of its continued fraction terms.
from-generalized-continued-fraction: Reconstruct a number from the list of its generalized continued fraction terms.
from-number-expansion: Gives a rational approximation of a real number using different kinds of commonly known series expansions.
integer-digits: Gives a list of the base $b digits of the integer $n.
integer-exponent: Gives the highest power of b that divides n. C<$n> -- Integer. C<$b> -- (Base) integer.
integer-partitions: Give a list of all possible ways to partition the integer argument into smaller integers.
is-abundant-number: Check whether an input is an abundant number. An abundant number is a number whose sum of proper divisors is greater than the number itself. The proper divisors of an integer n are the positive integers less than n that divide n.
is-composite: Gives true if the number is not prime.
is-deficient-number: Check whether an input is a deficient number. A deficient number is a number whose sum of proper divisors is less than the number itself. The proper divisors of an integer n are the positive integers less than n that divide n.
is-happy-number: Test whether an integer is a happy number.
is-harshad-number: Test whether an integer is a harshad ("joyful") number.
is-perfect-number: Check whether an input is a perfect number.
is-prime-gaussian: Gives True if the argument is Gaussian prime. C<:$p> -- An integer or complex number or a list of numbers.
is-prime-power: Gives true the number is a power of a prime.
is-quadratic-irrational: Give true if the argument is quadratic irrational.
kronecker-delta: Gives the Kronecker delta value, which is equal to 1 if all the arguments are equal, and 0 otherwise.
liouville-lambda: Gives the Liouville lambda function λ(n).
lucas-l: Give the n-th Lucas L number. C<$n> -- Non-negative integer or a list of non-negative integers.
mangold-lambda: Give Mangold lambda for an integer
modular-inverse: Give the modular inverse of $k modulo $n.
multiplicative-order: Give the multiplicative order of $k modulo $n. Defined as the smallest integer $m such that $k^$m = 1 mod $n.
next-prime: Give the smallest prime number above the argument. C<:$x> -- A number or a list of numbers. C<:$k> -- An integer or a list of integers.
number-expansion: Expresses a number as an expansion using any of several methods.
phi-number-system: Phi number system. C<$n> -- An integer number to convert. C<:$tol> -- Tolerance to stop the conversion with. C<:$length> -- Max number of digits.
power-mod: Give $b^$e mod $m. If $m is -1 the sub finds the modular inverse of a modulo $m.
powers-representations: Give the distinct representations of the integer $n as a sum of $k non-negative $p^th integer powers.
prime: Give the n-th prime number. C<$n> -- Prime number index or a list of indexes.
prime-nu: Give the number of distinct primes in the argument.
prime-omega: Give the number of prime factors counting multiplicities Ω(n) in the argument.
prime-pi: Give the number of primes π(x) less than or equal to the argument.
primitive-root-list: Give a list of primitive roots of the argument.
quotient: Give the integer quotient of $m and $n.
quotient-reminder: Give a list of the quotient and remainder from division of $m by $n.
random-prime: Give pseudo random prime numbers in specified ranges. C<:$range> -- Integer or Range. C<:$n> -- Number of primes to return.
real-digits: Real digits C<$x> -- Number to convert. C<:$base> -- Conversion base. C<:$n> -- Digit exponent to start with. C<:$tol> -- Tolerance to stop the conversion with. C<:$length> -- Max number of digits.
related-primes: Get the first n-pairs of primes that differ by given step. C<$n> -- Number of first pairs. C<:diff(:difference(:$step))> -- Difference between each pair.
sexy-primes: Get the first n-pairs of primes that differ by 6.
spiral-lattice: Spiral square lattice C<$n> -- Square side size. C<:l(:end-corner(:$last-at))> -- Corner to finish the spiral at. C<:d(:$dataset)> -- Should a dataset be returned or not.
squares-r: Give the number of ways r_d(n) to represent the integer n as a sum of d squares. r_d(n) gives the number of ways to write n_1^2 + ... + n_d^2 = n, where the n_i can be positive, negative, or zero. C<:$d> -- Number of squares. C<:$n> -- Integer to represent with a sum of squares.
sunflower-embedding: Sunflower embedding of integers from 1 to given upper limit. C<$n> -- A positive integer or a list of integers. C<:&with> -- Function to apply to each integer and add the result to the corresponding record. C<:d(:$dataset)> -- Should a dataset be returned or not? C<:a(:$angle)> -- Angle between successive points. If C<WhateverCode> then no such application and addition is done.
triangle-matrix-embedding: Gives a triangle within a matrix. C<$k> -- Number of rows of the embedding matrix. (Odd numbers only.) C<:na(:$missing-value))> -- Missing value. C<:d(:$dataset)> -- Should a dataset be returned or not.
twin-primes: Get the first n-pairs of primes that differ by 2.
